title: UI风格#112 - Desert Mirage (沙漠海市蜃楼)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Desert Mirage style When color palette Then features burnt orange, dusty pink, sage green, sand beige
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#CC5500 (焦橙), #D4A574 (沙粉), #9DC183 (鼠尾草), #F5DEB3 (沙米), #8B4513 (棕褐)
